metadata.description: Zero-auth free local MCP plugins for coding agents (Cursor marketplace). Paid Pro is a separate product outside this repo.

plugins.name: dev-microtools
plugins.description: Changelog briefs, semver risk, JWT inspect, cron explain, OpenAPI diff, stack parse, env key diff.

plugins.name: log-fingerprint
plugins.description: Fingerprint and cluster noisy logs, detect spikes, and brief error budgets — local, zero-auth.

plugins.name: env-contract
plugins.description: Infer env contracts, check drift, render safe .env.example, and overlap-check docker-compose env.

plugins.name: sql-migration-guard
plugins.description: Heuristic SQL migration risk scanning, order checks, rollback sketches, and lock notes — local, zero-auth.

plugins.name: har-diff
plugins.description: Compare HTTP Archive (HAR) captures for status/timing/size regressions, list failing requests, scan cookie names/flags — local, zero-auth.

plugins.name: release-notes-forge
plugins.description: Turn conventional commits into release notes, flag breakings, suggest semver — local, zero-auth, free.

plugins.name: json-schema-fixtures
plugins.description: Validate JSON against schemas, generate fixtures, diff schemas — local, zero-auth, free.

plugins.name: git-archaeology
plugins.description: Blame digests, churn hotspots, why-here briefs, and diff risk heuristics — local, zero-auth, free.

plugins.name: dockerfile-lint-lite
plugins.description: Heuristic Dockerfile and compose risk scans — local, zero-auth, free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: openapi-mock-lite
plugins.description: Load OpenAPI specs, mock responses, find coverage gaps, heuristic security scan — free marketplace funnel.
